apps.name: VT Image Helper
apps.desc: Find beautiful, text ready images for the slides behind your service, and share the good ones with everyone else.

apps.name: Visual T'filah Sign-Up
apps.desc: Congregants claim a prayer and bring their own image to carry it on screen during the service.
apps.note: Opens in demo mode. The real sign-up asks a congregation for its access word.

apps.name: Siddur OCR
apps.desc: Turn scanned prayer book pages into clean Word documents for blind and low vision worshipers.
apps.note: Runs on a Claude API key you supply. Nothing is sent to a server of mine.

apps.name: Layout Lab
apps.desc: Mark up the anatomy of a prayer book page so the next scan reads it in the right order.

apps.name: Digital Mensches
apps.desc: Ten guidelines for ethical online behavior, with the programs a camp or school needs to teach them.

apps.name: Torah Navigator
apps.desc: Point a camera at the open scroll and find your place in the Torah reading.
apps.note: Needs a camera and a Claude API key you supply.

apps.name: Glyph Rush
apps.desc: A daily minute of symbol speed. Find the twin, spot the impostor, scan the row.

apps.name: Blacktop
apps.desc: A racing game drawn entirely in black lines on paper white, built as an homage to my father's Race Car Simulator.

apps.name: Race Car Simulator
apps.desc: My father's 1985 Macintosh racing game, possibly the first 3D racer on the Mac, rebuilt to run in a browser.

apps.name: Alien World
apps.desc: Walk out into an endless landscape of crystal spires, bioluminescent flora, and purple highlands.

apps.name: Device Builder
apps.desc: A slider workshop for shaping the handheld device you carry through Alien World.

apps.name: Fob Builder
apps.desc: A slider workshop for shaping the fob you carry through Alien World.

apps.name: Cosmic Drift
apps.desc: Clear waves of drifting blocks, then spend what you salvage on a better ship.

apps.name: Cosmic Workshop
apps.desc: Build your own levels, blocks, ships, and effects for Cosmic Drift.

apps.name: Streams
apps.desc: A living aquarium painted in three inks. Click the water to feed the fish.

apps.name: Thread Hiker
apps.desc: Take a walk across the surface of Passages, a fiber art piece by my father, Steve Medwin.

apps.name: Threads
apps.desc: Look up any Madeira Polyneon embroidery thread and find its closest Pantone match.

apps.name: Binah
apps.desc: A daily digest of the artificial intelligence news that matters for faith, ethics, and Jewish life.

apps.name: Family Dinner Planner
apps.desc: Plan the week's dinners together so nobody ends up staring into the fridge at six o'clock.
apps.note: Opens a demo family you can play with. The real planner needs an account, since the point is a shared plan.

apps.name: Family Dinner Planner Guide
apps.desc: How the dinner planner works, from the first sign in to a full week of meals.

apps.name: Mailbox Lab
apps.desc: Design a laser cut mailbox for the hallway board, then export the sheets to cut.

apps.name: Tech Rabbi
apps.desc: The main site. Who I am, what I do, and how to reach me.

apps.name: Palimpsest
apps.desc: A manuscript that fades instead of vanishing, written and rewritten as you watch.

apps.name: Latent Sky
apps.desc: The space inside a language model, drawn as a night sky you can fly through.
